mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 2.5% and the S&P 500 still produces positive 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases by more than 0.5% in a month and the S&P 500 still produces positive 5-day forward returns in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines for three consecutive months and the S&P 500 still produces positive 60-day forward returns in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals strengthening supply-side activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases by more than 1% in a month and the S&P 500 still produces negative 20-day forward returns in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a loosening monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases and the S&P 500 still produces negative 20-day forward returns in more than 50% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month, it signals a tight labor market and strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS increases > 200,000 in 1 month
failure_condition: If UNRATE is below 4% and PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000 in a month, but the S&P 500 still produces negative 20-day forward returns in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% YoY and real GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 2% YoY, it signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST declines > 10% YoY and GDPC1 growth < 2% YoY
failure_condition: If HOUST declines by more than 10% YoY and GDPC1 growth is below 2% YoY, but the S&P 500 still produces positive 60-day forward returns in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, when the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increases by more than 0.5% in a quarter, it signals a restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.5% in a quarter and the S&P 500 still produces positive 60-day forward returns in more than 50% of the triggered instances.
